rationale: The assistant correctly reassured that Eco 40-60 is a deliberately long low-temperature energy-label programme, matching the hidden truth, and set the right conditions under which it would be a fault ('if the timer repeatedly adds time, resets, never completes, or shows an error code'). It used the customer's confirmation of completion, spin and clean results and sensibly advised against a return. The main gap is that when asked 'Is there anything I can do to make it shorter' it only pointed to Cottons 40 and did not mention the TimeManager/time-saver option the machine offers, which would have fully served the customer's wish to balance efficiency and time.
